_fixture: RETURNS_ORDER_F_CANCELLED_LINE — Swagger-shaped create body for POST /api/order/customerOrders (VCST-5628, buyer's own returns step 1). A live line delivered today PLUS a cancelled line, in one order. The cancelled line must be excluded while the live line stays returnable.
_contract: Every `_`-prefixed key is FIXTURE METADATA, stripped by the seeder before the POST. Line identity comes from live discovery; delivery dates come from `_deliveryOffsetDays` resolved against seed-time now. There is NO literal date and NO runtime GUID in this file — the created order id, its line item ids and the resolved delivery instants are written to test-data/aliases.<env>.json.
_seedPhases: PHASE 1 POST creates the order (the platform ASSIGNS line item ids and IGNORES client-supplied ones, so shipment items cannot be linked at create). PHASE 2 PUT stamps shipments[].items[] with the assigned lineItemId + the inline lineItem object (without the inline object the platform silently drops the shipment item), the shipment deliveryDate, and any line cancellation.
